payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and protocols for evaluating segmentation quality, including comparisons with a manually annotated reference corpus and performance metrics like F-score and recall.

claims.text: Segmentation quality is evaluated by comparing automatic segmentations against a manually annotated reference corpus, such as the Annodis corpus.
An evaluation protocol was established to measure the performance of segmenters, focusing on metrics like F-score and recall.
The evaluation includes comparing the performance of different segmentation systems and analyzing the impact of various markers on segmentation quality.
